style: Refine every catalog object toward warm, softly lit cartoon art, consistent with the selected plant reference. Preserve identity, function and original palette family. Keep registered camera, dimensions, roots, sockets, ports, footprints and animation timing. No preferred horizontal light direction for rotatable world sprites; no directional ground shadows. Real 3D render output, editable Blender sources. The source 2D effects remain explicitly identified as 2D. Each object receives fresh independent editor/judge agents. Publish object-by-object to the same PR preview; integrate approved sprites into Godot after catalog review checks. Follow-on design exploration: improve the modeling itself, including forms, proportions, structure, crafted details and decorations. Original part counts and awkward geometry are not constraints. The editor may rebuild native geometry to achieve the better design; the judge should reward useful improvements. Preserve the locked registration, gameplay contact/clearance, animation and modular continuity contract. See modeling-policy.json version2.

source.scene: Inspect the named asset collection; do not use an unrelated active scene

target.interpretation: Reward useful native modeling and decoration inspired by the target. Do not reject a change solely because it differs from the source. Reject target drift only when it harms the chosen style, readability, role or locked technical contract. Original part counts and weak shapes are not automatically constraints.

Ama Mensah retains dark-brown skin, short dark-brown fringe, golden-yellow folded headwrap, ivory coat, GREEN apron AND necktie, dark shoes. Target skin/framing/halo and family different hat/colors are not authority.

Preserve native root uniform1.25 scale, functional1.525 height, original one-cell body/clearance envelope, existing ground and action contact behavior. aestheticOutcomes.success: Headwrap reads as purposeful folded golden cloth with broad legible fold transitions, a coherent band and knot/wrap structure. Top, side and back have deliberate volume instead of an angular blank cap or razor-thin facade. Better proportions are welcome inside the locked envelope.

Friendly readable cartoon face retains Ama identity. Dark short fringe, hair mass, ears, face/nose and headwrap connect coherently; profiles remain appealing and clear. Avoid detached features, broken hair-to-hat gaps, overgrown fringe or blank faceless-looking profiles caused by collapsed feature depth.

Coat, collar/cuffs, green tie, apron bib/waist/skirt and limbs have intentional connected proportions and readable cloth construction. Forms look comfortably rounded and crafted rather than stacked slabs or inflated beads; original awkward shapes may be rebuilt.

Rich dark-brown skin and dark-brown hair remain distinct; golden-yellow wrap, warm ivory coat, green tie/apron and dark shoes stay legible as separate palette families under the warm light. Avoid orange/light skin drift, fluorescent flat yellow, muddy near-black apron or wholesale tinting that erases material separation.

Broad soft highlights and gentle warm shade transitions describe crown folds, rounded face, collar/sleeve volume and apron shape across all facings. Golden/ivory areas retain shading and color instead of clipping to flat white; dark regions retain useful volume. No artificial halo, harsh light seam or baked directional cast shadow.

A restrained set of visible crafted garment details makes the apron and chef role feel finished: functional edges, pocket/waist/tie/collar structure or equivalent useful decoration. Details must survive at logical size and belong to the same cloth language. Exact target stitches, buttons, seam counts and source part counts are not required; decorative noise or unreadable microtexture is not a substitute for shape.

At logical192x320 with registered scale, front/profile/rear silhouettes, friendly face where visible, wrap folds, ivory/green garment divisions, hands, shoes and active knife/dish remain readable. Inspect light/gray/dark backgrounds and repeated/use-context preview without upscaling to excuse disappearing detail.

N/E/S/W read as the same coherent constructed character. Side/rear cloth, hair, garment and wrap transitions have deliberate volume and finish; no front-only quality or large dead blank slabs. The single front target does not dictate unseen shapes.

No material black patches, coplanar shimmer, ragged geometry ends, hollow garment gaps, visible intersections, broken corners, abrupt unintended normals/seams, blown highlight flats, clipping, alpha halos or detached specks. Intentional pupils/dark hair/shoes/contact creases are judged as designed forms, not defects by darkness alone.

Every clip/facing retains stable topology and clean shape/material transitions over all frames. Feet stay grounded with original anchoring; sleeves/hands remain attached; knife grip/work action, held dish and load transfer are continuous, correctly occluded and plausible at the original functional contacts. No sliding/hovering hands, dish tunneling, knife through body, popping visibility, distorted apron/tie, texture swimming or loop-boundary snap; preserve load completion and nonloop behavior.

requiredReviewEvidence.packet: Immutable hash-bound packet including exact reopened editable source, all192 native PNGs/atlas rect references, all16 clips/facing motion previews, fixed target, validation, resources, registration and render settings. Record measured root rotation or matrix for each direction.
requiredReviewEvidence.visual: Inspect all192 frames directly or via verified labeled contact sheets, all16 motion previews, four-view sheet, repeated/use-context preview, logical-size and enlarged crops on light/gray/dark. Full frame sheets may be supplemented with detail crops; do not silently omit frames.
requiredReviewEvidence.native: Numerical camera/root/unit-axis calibration; actual evaluated per-frame body/functional bounds and scale; bone/action compatibility and rest/topology stability; visible foot/hand/dish/knife/load surface contact evidence against evaluated source baseline; complete clip/frame/direction/timing/layout audit; source/resource/render SHA-256 binding.
requiredReviewEvidence.limits: A manifest, source custom-property claim, bone coordinate list, unrendered model save or a single good idle/front still cannot certify the full result. Missing required evidence produces needs_evidence; visible defects produce revise.

qualityCriteria.approvalRule: Visible material improvement toward warm soft cartoon form/light/detail, every frozen outcome satisfied without material all-facing or motion defects, and passing native/registration/action contract. No universal numeric threshold; no candidate verdict at this stage.

delivery.scope: Refine this object only. Root coordinator promotes approved atlases, sources and metadata to production, publishes the PR preview, and finally updates Godot.
delivery.notes: Write source/round-NN.blend or the actual native 2D source as appropriate; full native captures, original-layout atlases, previews, validation and delivery.json. Do not label 2D artwork as a Blender model.
